item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day has a lot of moments built in for slowing down, and water is the simplest one to pair with them. Mental clarity, patience, and steady mood all drop when you're even mildly dehydrated. Start by drinking a full glass of water before your morning routine, then keep a bottle within reach through the afternoon. Action: drink one full glass of water right now.
